role: Real fallback/retry layer wrapping ai-gateway's real generateText() — found by checking the actual live code: it's a dumb dispatch requiring the caller to already know the provider, no fallback on failure. Given the person is about to run Groq's free tier, rate-limit retry is the real, urgent gap this closes.
behaviorDescription: routeWithFallback() tries each real provider in order, falling back only on a real retryable error (RATE_LIMITED, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE) and stopping immediately on a terminal one, verified against real cases before implementation. Wraps ai-gateway's real generateText() — inherits whatever real adapters exist there (Groq today).
hardStops: Never retries a real terminal error (bad request, not implemented) — wastes a call for nothing
Never fabricates a provider result — reports the real attempt outcome only
